test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All gadgets are electronics.

Some electronics are wirelesses.

Some wirelesses are toys.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gadgets are toys.

II. Some electronics are gadgets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements:

All gadgets are electronics.

Some electronics are wirelesses.

Some wirelesses are toys.

The possible Venn diagram is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00b30a696880428b19b05fc3d84679ae8e771900475526d1c0aab0bf413a2dcc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some gadgets are toys. - False (Because, there is no direct relation between gadgets and toys so it can be possible but not possible)

II. Some electronics are gadgets. - True (Because, All gadgets are electronics. So Some electronics are gadgets, it is definite)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion II follows".
